  "rationale": "The goal bar (0.8811 balanced_accuracy) sits above the baseline ranking's own ceiling of 0.8382, so no re-cut of the logistic ranking can reach it — the required KS is 0.7622 against the baseline's 0.6765. Trees also handle the 'unknown' sentinel levels in V4<path> natively as one-hot indicator columns, so those caveated columns cost nothing and no imputation guesswork is applied to them; the card reports 0% true missingness, so missing_indicator<path> would add constant columns and are omitted. class_weight='balanced' (7.55:1) is included because balanced_accuracy is the mean of recall and specificity and the unweighted default at 11.7% positives cuts far into the specificity side (baseline recall 0.345 vs accuracy 0.902); 'balanced' is one point on that lever, not the optimum, and attempt 2 can move it explicitly (e.g. {\"0\":1,\"1\":4} or {\"0\":1,\"1\":12}) once cut_headroom shows how much of the remaining gap is operating point rather than ranking.
